name: Maid Hakusho
source:
All-Japan Maid Championship will be held in 3 months and you need to choose your champion out of four candidates and train her into the best maid Japan ever seen.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
全日本女仆锦标赛将在三个月后举行。你必须从四名候选人中选出代表，训练她成为日本有史以来最出色的女仆。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-june-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
